Retired DGP Sreelekha Resigns as Thiruvananthapuram Corporation Councillor

Retired Director General of Police (DGP) R. Sreelekha has tendered her resignation as a councillor for the Thiruvananthapuram Corporation. Her resignation bid has reportedly put the ruling BJP in trouble within the corporation.
